'''Culvert''' is a small arena map for [[DMM4]] mode. It's a circular room, with a few obstructions in the center to force a bit more tactical fights. The obstructions are 6 round pillars, they are supposed to deny LG as the most obvious weapon of choice, and make RL more useful, which rarely is the case in for example [[Povdmm4]], the classic DMM4 map.
